bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; providing a onetime rate add-on for a nursing facility in Ely; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; BOUNDARY WATERS CARE CENTER. +]

[+$250,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a rate add-on under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 256R, for Boundary Waters Care Center in Ely. This is a onetime appropriation and must be paid without federal matching money. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; providing a onetime rate add-on for a nursing facility in Ely; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; BOUNDARY WATERS CARE CENTER.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a rate add-on under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 256R, for Boundary Waters Care Center in Ely. This is a onetime appropriation and must be paid without federal matching money.
